label: July 20–26, 2026
intro: This weekend is your LAST chance to catch Neo Land at ICONSIAM before it closes July 31 — combine it with a riverside walk while you're there.
weekday_note: Weekday Sub-Zero sessions are blissfully quiet and cheap (100 THB kids) — great for Thor to practise ice balance without the weekend crowd.

activities.title: Neo Land at ICONSIAM — Final Weekend
activities.location: ICONSIAM, Charoen Nakhon Rd (Saphan Taksin BTS + free shuttle boat)
activities.why: Large-scale immersive art festival at the riverside mega-mall — this weekend is the penultimate before it closes. Combine with the ICONSIAM riverside promenade for a bonus river adventure. Big lights, big visuals, just Thor's scale.
activities.tip: Take the free shuttle boat from Saphan Taksin Pier — Thor will love the river crossing. Morning visit beats evening crowds.

activities.title: Toob North at theCOMMONS Cloud 11
activities.price: Free to browse; workshops priced per session
activities.why: Northern Thai potters, weavers, and food makers have taken over the space. Thor can watch live clay work, try a hands-on session, eat khao soi, and explore handmade objects — ticks building & making all in one outing.
activities.tip: Weekday mornings are the quietest — makers are more chatty and hands-on when it's not packed. Weekend afternoons get lively.

activities.title: Roller Dome Emporium — Weekend Session
activities.location: Roller Dome, Emporium Shopping Mall, Sukhumvit Soi 24 (Phrom Phong BTS)
activities.price: 150 THB/hr weekends; 100 THB/hr weekdays; skate + protective gear included
activities.why: Southeast Asia's biggest indoor roller rink — perfect for Thor's rollerblading passion. Dedicated grass practice area for beginners before the main floor. Coaches available. Fully air-conditioned.
activities.tip: Arrive at 10am opening to beat the lunch crowd. Helmets and knee pads included in rental.

activities.title: Sub-Zero Ice Skating — Weekday Daytime
activities.date: Any weekday (closed for maintenance some mornings — call ahead)
activities.location: Sub-Zero Ice Skate Club, Major Cineplex Sukhumvit (Ekkamai BTS, skywalk access)
activities.price: 100 THB kids / 200 THB adults; skate rental included. Wednesday discount: 90 THB/hr
activities.why: Weekday afternoons at Sub-Zero are nearly empty — Thor can work on ice balance without the weekend crush. Two rinks: Arena Rink for fun, Academy Rink for coaching. Bring a light jacket!
activities.tip: Wednesday is the cheapest day (90 THB/hr). A 60-min instructor session (~900 THB) produces visible progress in one visit.

activities.title: Kad Kokoa Kids Bonbon Chocolate Workshop
activities.date: Monthly sessions — check kadkokoa.co for upcoming dates
activities.price: Check kadkokoa.co for current session price
activities.why: Small-group kids bonbon-making workshop using real Thai craft chocolate. Thor makes and takes home his own chocolates — pure building & making joy for a 5-year-old who already loved the chocolate session.
activities.tip: Dates sell fast. Check kadkokoa.co/products/kids-chocolate-bon-bon-workshop now and book ahead. Follow their LINE Official for new date alerts.

activities.title: ClassBento Kids Ceramic Workshop
activities.date: Book any available slot at classbento.co.th
activities.location: Multiple Bangkok studios (central BKK / Thonglor area)
activities.price: Check classbento.co.th for current session prices
activities.why: Hands-on pinch pots, slabs, and coils for kids age 5+. Thor gets to build and decorate something from scratch — same clay energy as the pottery sessions he already loves.
activities.tip: Book at classbento.co.th/ceramic-workshop-for-kids. Weekend slots fill fast — book at least a week ahead.

activities.title: The Marvel Experience Thailand
activities.date: Ongoing — book any day via Klook or Viator
activities.time: Check Klook for current show times
activities.location: Bang Kaeo, Bang Phli, Samut Prakan — next to Mega Bangna (BTS On Nut + Grab ~30 min)
activities.price: Discounted tickets on Klook (up to 45% off vs door price)
activities.why: Iron Man's Stark Mobile Lab, 4D stereoscopic dome, VR flight training, and character meet-and-greets with Iron Man, Thor the Avenger, Spider-Man, and Hulk. Built for exactly a 5-year-old Iron Man fan.
activities.tip: Book on Klook ahead for best price. Weekday mornings have shortest queues. Allow 2 hours minimum.
